description.short: Foundry spend, token usage, budgets and limits from Azure REST APIs
description.full: Sign in with your Microsoft Entra ID account to report on Microsoft Foundry spend and usage across your Azure subscriptions: billed cost by project, agent, model and team; near-real-time token usage; Foundry cost controls; Cost Management budgets; quota and deployments; tags; alert rules; and Azure API Management AI-gateway token limits. Runs every call with your own Azure permissions. Includes guided skills for FinOps reports and for safely changing budgets, cost controls and token limits.

agentConnectors.description: Microsoft Foundry cost, token usage, cost controls, budgets, quota, tags, alerts and AI-gateway token limits, using the signed-in user's Azure permissions.
